summary: Fixed-capacity pool slot allocator. Returns a pointer to one slot of a 32-entry static array (stride 56 bytes starting at unk_8AD3F8), using the global counter dword_8ADAF8 as the next free index and post-incrementing it. Once the counter reaches 32 the pool is exhausted and the function returns a fixed overflow buffer (unk_8ADAC0). Used by collision detection paths that need temporary per-call records.

operations.description: Guard on dword_8ADAF8 >= 32: when the pool counter has reached capacity, return the fixed overflow buffer &unk_8ADAC0 instead of a pooled slot.
Pooled path: return &unk_8AD3F8 + 56 * dword_8ADAF8, then post-increment the pool counter dword_8ADAF8 so the next call takes the following slot.
Consumed by F_3DCollisionDetectionWithAABBTestAndContactResp (0x004EA040) and CollisionDetectionSystem (0x004EA970) to acquire temporary collision records.
